newsitem.title: JAPAN: China to adopt personal handyphone system - paper.
newsitem.headline: China to adopt personal handyphone system - paper.

text.p: China has decided to adopt the personal handyphone system (PHS) as one of its wireless telecommunications systems, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun quoted Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry as saying the Chinese government has already allocated frequency bands for PHS, allowing for the introduction of the system in areas where telecommunications facilities are not yet available.
The decision may boost output of related equipment and products in China and also increase imports from Japan, the paper said.
PHS, which was developed in Japan, is cheaper to use than cellular phones and has a greater range than cordless phones, but cannot be used in moving vehicles.
